    Bug 1985423 - Update components/devtools to use moz-src. r=mkmelin
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D262735

diff --git a/mail/components/devtools/components.conf b/mail/components/devtools/components.conf
index c3ce23ab877..06b240e42c0 100644
--- a/mail/components/devtools/components.conf
+++ b/mail/components/devtools/components.conf
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@ Classes = [
   {
     'cid': '{089694e9-106a-4704-abf7-62a88545e194}',
     'contract_ids': ['@mozilla.org/messenger/devtools-startup-clh;1'],
-    'esModule': 'resource:///modules/devtools-loader.sys.mjs',
+    'esModule': 'moz-src:///comm/mail/components/devtools/devtools-loader.sys.mjs',
     'constructor': 'DevToolsStartup',
     'categories': {'command-line-handler': 'm-aaa-tb-devtools'},
   },
diff --git a/mail/components/devtools/devtools-loader.sys.mjs b/mail/components/devtools/devtools-loader.sys.mjs
index de949ea7d9b..51a4e2bb0a0 100644
--- a/mail/components/devtools/devtools-loader.sys.mjs
+++ b/mail/components/devtools/devtools-loader.sys.mjs
@@ -56,7 +56,7 @@ DevToolsStartup.prototype = {
       if (options.root) {
         const {
           createRootActor,
-        } = require("resource:///modules/tb-root-actor.js");
+        } = require("moz-src:///comm/mail/components/devtools/tb-root-actor.js");
         DevToolsServer.setRootActor(createRootActor);
       }
     };
diff --git a/mail/components/devtools/moz.build b/mail/components/devtools/moz.build
index 900ab4fb1d9..1d9a96836d8 100644
--- a/mail/components/devtools/moz.build
+++ b/mail/components/devtools/moz.build
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@
 with Files("**"):
     BUG_COMPONENT = ("Thunderbird", "General")
 
-EXTRA_JS_MODULES += [
+MOZ_SRC_FILES += [
     "devtools-loader.sys.mjs",
     "tb-root-actor.js",
 ]
